items.title: AVENEW launches St. Regis Residences on Dubai Islands
items.summary: Beachfront development of 248 residences across two buildings, branded with Marriott's St. Regis, with one- to five-bedroom homes including penthouses. Prices not stated.

items.title: BAYN Phase 1 construction under way on the Ghantoot coast
items.summary: First residential launch of 464 villas and townhouses sold out within 72 hours. Dh1.9bn Phase 1 contract awarded to UNEC, main works began June 2026, first handovers targeted for Q4 2028.
